type: continuous-column sentinel detection, the last recorded blind spot in the audit

the_first_rule_failed.rule: outside the rest's range and farther from it than half the range
the_first_rule_failed.missed: a zero fill among log-normal concentrations, which sits only micro-units below the minimum in absolute terms
the_first_rule_failed.fix: compare with the column median; off-scale by more than a hundredfold

an_honest_characterisation.what_it_is: a catalogue of the mistakes actually made in this programme
an_honest_characterisation.why: every rule was reverse-engineered from a failure rather than derived from theory
an_honest_characterisation.consequence: good at catching those mistakes again, poor at catching mistakes nobody here has made yet

not_targeted: a sentinel in the middle of a distribution, such as a missing value filled with the mean, which is numerically indistinguishable from a real value
limits: The 2 percent and hundredfold thresholds are chosen, not optimised.
All rules are empirically derived with no independent guarantee.
next_gate: close the tool line and return to science: combine the criterion-resolution matrix with the data-volume robustness result into a decision table for which criterion to use at what sample size
